verdict.rationale: Jira's features page directly claims pre-built, customizable project templates covering use cases from agile sprints to marketing campaigns, which matches the story of jumpstarting a new project. The support rests on a single marketing-level line. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the template catalog and setup flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of template quality.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Start fast with pre-built and customizable templates for any project, from agile sprints to marketing campaigns.
